julesThoughtProcess: I chose a vibrant neon amber (#FF9100) to evoke the warmth of streetlights and neon signs in a high-tech society, highlighting grounded optimism and human resilience against the stark black contrast.
storyPanel: Beneath the glowing mag-lev tracks, Jax repairs everyday cybernetics at their small corner stand. It’s gritty work, often dealing with the frustration of outdated tech and fraying cables. Yet, amidst the hum of hover-traffic and sudden power flickers, Jax always has a warm smile and a steady hand. They don't just fix broken limbs; they offer a quiet moment of connection in a chaotic, sprawling city—proving that even in a world of complex machines, simple human kindness remains the most vital circuitry.
